name: 26 July 2005 · the 944 mm day (peak-window reconstruction)
note: Mumbai's benchmark catastrophe: 944 mm in 24 h at Santacruz, with an afternoon peak that broke every drainage assumption the city had. This replay reconstructs the worst 3-hour window at AWS cadence, coinciding — as it did that day — with a high spring tide. Values synthesized from IMD/press records of the event.
